checks.name: Apache web server
checks.solution:
Run: sudo systemctl start apache2
If it fails to start: sudo journalctl -xe | grep apache

checks.name: PHP info page
checks.solution:
Confirm phpinfo.php exists in /var/www/html/. If missing, check the piClinic www/html deployment.
If the file exists but returns 404, check Apache config: sudo a2enmod php8 && sudo systemctl restart apache2

checks.name: MySQL connectivity
checks.solution:
If MySQL is not running: sudo systemctl start mysql
If authentication fails, check credentials in ~/piClinic/www/html/local/config.php
If the admin user does not exist, run the DB setup section of piClinicVMSetup.sh

checks.name: Composer
checks.solution:
Install Composer:
  php -r "copy('https://getcomposer.org/installer', 'composer-setup.php');"
  php composer-setup.php
  sudo mv composer.phar /usr/local/bin/composer

checks.name: Node.js
checks.solution:
Install Node via apt: sudo apt install nodejs
Or via nvm: nvm install --lts

checks.name: npm
checks.solution:
npm is normally installed with Node. Run: sudo apt install npm
Or reinstall Node via nvm.

checks.name: PHPUnit
checks.solution:
Run from the piClinic backend directory: composer install
Or install globally: sudo composer global require phpunit/phpunit

checks.name: Git branch
checks.solution:
If the branch is missing: git fetch origin && git checkout react-refactor
If the repo is not present, re-clone from GitHub per the setup script.
